infoLinks.urlText: Some trains at Hawkesbury River and Cowan leave from different platforms. If travelling to Cowan you may need to change at Hawkesbury River for a bus
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 1 November
  • From 5.30am to 11am, at Hawkesbury River and Cowan, all trains leave from platform 2.

  • From 7am to 10.30am, trains towards Hornsby do not stop at Cowan.
  • Buses run from Hawkesbury River to Cowan, and from Cowan to Berowra, in that direction only.
  • Change at Hawkesbury River for a bus to Cowan. From Cowan, catch a bus to Berowra then change for a train to continue your journey.
  • Trains towards Gosford continue to stop at Cowan.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
50CN Hawkesbury River, Cowan, Berowra (in that direction only)

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 29 and Thursday 30 October
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Change at Central for buses to Kings Cross, Edgecliff and Bondi Junction or metro services to Martin Place.

  • From 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek, or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD Martin Place diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
From 12pm until 2.30pm on Sunday 19 October, route 308 & 320 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
 
Buses will divert away from the CBD via Albion Street, Crown Street and Foveaux Street to return to route on Eizabeth Street.  
 
Check signs at stops, continue on foot and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed stops:  
  • Elizabeth St at Hay St (200047) 
  • Pitt St opp Barlow St (200083) 
  • Central Station, Eddy Ave, Stand C (200053)

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill Line partial closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Saturday 1 to Friday 7 November, L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will not run between Central and Convention due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
  • L1 light rail services will continue to run between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • Use alternative transport including regular bus services, L1 replacement bus services, or walking if able to, between Central Grand Concourse and Convention.
  • Due to road closures, L1 replacement buses will only stop at Central Grand Concourse, Convention and The Star. There will be no replacement buses at the following stops: Capitol Square, Paddy’s Markets, Exhibition Centre, Pyrmont Bay.
L1 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am on Saturday 8 November.
 
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 19 October, route 311 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
 
From 11.45am until 1.30pm, route 311 services travelling towards Central will divert via Crown Street, Foveaux Street, Elizabeth Street and Eddy Avenue and end trips at Central Station, Eddy Ave, Stand A (200039). 
 
From 12.15pm until 2.30pm, route 311 services will travelling towards Millers Point/Walsh Point will divert via Riley Street and end trips at Riley St opp Kennedy St (201157).

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. You may need to change trains to continue your journey
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 1 and Sunday 2 November
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Macarthur and Sydenham, or between Revesby and Central via the Airport.
  • Change at:
    - Revesby for trains to Airport stations
    - Sydenham for T4 trains towards Bondi Junction. Metro services do not run.
  • Early morning and late-night trains run between Macarthur and Central via the Airport.

  • T8 trains do not run between Sydenham and the City. T4 trains run between Sydenham and Bondi Junction, making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

  • Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel. Use light rail or local buses to continue your journey.

  • Read more about weekend service changes in the City.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.

Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.

Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
Work will take place between 7AM to 6PM, Monday to Friday and 8AM to 1PM on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

infoLinks.urlText: City Circle: Trains do not run to Museum, St James or Circular Quay
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 October
  • Trains do not run to Museum, St James or Circular Quay but continue to run between Central, Town Hall and Wynyard.
  • Light rail services run between Central and Circular Quay.
  • If you are travelling to:
    • Circular Quay, change at Wynyard for the light rail or walk
    • Museum or St James, change at Central or Town Hall for local buses or walk

  • Trackwork also affects trains on other lines.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:

Buses travelling towards Bondi Junction will divert via Albion Street and Crown Street to return to route on Oxford Street.  
 
Buses travelling towards Rozelle will divert via Crown Street Albion Street and Crown Street, Foveaux Street and Elizabeth Street to return to route on Eddy Avenue.  
 
Check signs at stops and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
From 12pm until 2.30pm on Sunday 19 October, route 500x and 506 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation. 

Buses to the city will end trips at Town Hall House, Druitt St Stand N (2000282). 
 
Buses leaving the city will start trips from Town Hall House, Druitt St, Stand L (2000423). 
 
Stops between Town Hall and The Domain Sydney will be missed. Continue on foot and allow extra time. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Town Hall Station, Park St, Stand H (2000249) (500x, 506)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Chatswood and Sydenham
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 1 and Sunday 2 November
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • Trackwork also affects trains in the City. For travel between Chatswood and Sydenham use:
    - T1 trains between Chatswood and Wynyard or T9 trains between Epping and Central
    - T4 trains between Martin Place and Sydenham
    - L2 or L3 light rail services between Wynyard and Central.
  •  For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Read more about weekend service changes in the City.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line partial closure during Parramatta Lanes
infoLinks.content:
From Wednesday 22 to Saturday 25 October, due to road closures and for pedestrian safety during Parramatta Lanes, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta Square during the following times: 
  • From 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October  
  • From 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October  
Light rail services will continue to run between Parramatta Square and Carlingford. 

During this time, use alternative transport including trains, regular bus services, L4 replacement bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Parramatta Square. 

L4 replacement bus services: 

Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October, and from 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October. These times may vary depending on road traffic. 

Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations: 
  • Westmead Hospital – please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minutes walk) 
  • Ngara – please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minutes walk) 
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service. 

Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected. 

Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info.

urlText: South West Sydney bus changes from Sunday 14 September
content:
From Sunday 14 September, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western and South West Sydney.
 
The changes improve reliability and connectivity, with new timetables introduced on routes 901, 902, 902X, 903, 904, 905, 906, 907, 908, 909, 911, 913, 914, 916, 925, M90, M91, S1, S3 and S5.
 
Adjustments will also be made to some school services. See our news story for more details.
 
Please use the Trip Planner to see if these changes affect your travel.
subtitle: South West Sydney bus changes from Sunday 14 September

infoLinks.content:
From 11.45am until 1.30pm on Sunday 19 October, routes 333 & 396 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
 
Buses travelling towards Circular Quay will divert away from the CBD via Crown Street, Foveaux Street, Elizabeth Street and Eddy Avenue to end trips at Central Station, Eddy Ave, Stand A (200039).  
 
Buses leaving the city will start trips at Oxford St at Palmer St (201058). 
 
Stops between Museum Station and Circular Quay will be missed in both directions. Check signs at stops, catch trains or continue on foot. 
 
Missed stops:

infoLinks.urlText: Crows Nest bus diversions
infoLinks.content:
From 12:01am until 11pm on Sunday 19 October, route 263 services will be starting and ending trips at different stops in Crows Nest due to road closures for the Crows Nest Fest event.
 
Stops on Willoughby Rd and Burlington St will be missed.
 
Buses to the city will start trips from Ernest St at West St Crows Nest (Stop ID 2065104).
Buses from the city to Crows Nest will end trips at Ernest St at West St Crows Nest (Stop ID 2065106).
 
Continue on foot via Ernest St to access Willoughby Rd. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. See the event page for more information.
 
Closed stops
  • Willoughby Rd after Holtermann St (Stop ID 206538)
  • Crows Nest, Burlington St, Stand D (Stop ID 206540)

infoLinks.urlText: L1, L2 and L3 light rail services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed due to a Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 19 October, L1 Dulwich Hill Line, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services may be impacted between 11.45am and 2.30pm approximately for two planned Police Operation protest marches:  
  • L1 services may be temporarily held at stops, or partially closed between Central Grand Concourse and Convention, or 
  • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall or Central.  
Impact to services and timings may change at the direction of NSW Police. 
 
Please check information screens at stops, listen to announcements and follow the direction of staff or Police on site, as necessary. 
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner for alternative transport options, including trains, buses or walking.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for Fridayz Live and Triathlon Pink
infoLinks.content:
From 2am Saturday 18 October to 2pm Sunday 19 October, routes 525 and 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Fridayz Live Concert and the Triathlon Pink Fun Run.
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations.

    • Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712)

    • Alternative stop: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue (212736)

infoLinks.urlText: Rhodes diversions during Fun Run
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 26 October
  • From 5am to 11am, Route 526 services will start and end their trips at Olympic Park Wharf. Buses will not continue along the Bennelong Bridge to and from Rhodes due to road closures for the Billbergia Bennelong Bridge Run fun run event.  
  • Stops on Footbridge Boulevard, Gauthorpe Street, Marquet Street and Rider Boulevard will be missed. 
  • Passengers needing to access Rhodes can catch buses to Olympic Park Station to connect with Route 533 services leaving from Park Street towards Rhodes. 
  • Allow extra travel time. Visit the Billbergia Bennelong Bridge Run website for more details.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 29 and Thursday 30 October
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall or Cronulla and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
From 11.45am until 2.30pm on Sunday 19 October, route 304 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
 
Buses travelling towards Circular Quay will divert via Elizabeth Street and Eddy Avenue to end trips at Central Station, Eddy Ave, Stand A (200039).  
 
Buses leaving the city will start trips at Harmony Park, Hunt St (201026 ). 
 
Stops between Museum Station and Circular Quay will be missed in both directions. Check signs at stops, catch trains or continue on foot.

infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Milsons Point. Use metro between Chatswood and the City
infoLinks.content:
Monday 27 and Tuesday 28 October
  • Nightly from 9.15pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Hornsby to Milsons Point.
  • The last train from Hornsby to the City leaves Hornsby at 21:12, arriving Wynyard at 21:55.

  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Milsons Point to Hornsby.
  • The last train to Hornsby leaves Wynyard at 21:52, arriving Hornsby at 22:35.
  • Replacement buses also stop at Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations.
  • Use metro services between Chatswood, Crows Nest or Victoria Cross and the City.
  • T9 trains run between Berowra or Hornsby and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Some late-night buses run between T1 North Shore Line stations and Wynyard.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
97T1 Chatswood, all stations to Milsons Point (including Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations)
and return (late-night services extend to Wynyard)
98T1 Hornsby, all stations to Chatswood and return

lines.description: Sydney Olympic Park to Chatswood via Rhodes & North Ryde

urlText: Wentworth Point diversions during Fun Run
content:
Sunday 26 October
  • From 5am to 11am, Route 533 services will not run via the Bennelong Bridge and Wentworth Point due to road closures for the Billbergia Bennelong Bridge Run fun run event.  
  • Stops on Bennelong Bridge, Footbridge Boulevard, Hill Road and Holker Busway will be missed.  
  • Route 533 towards Sydney Olympic Park services will pick up and drop off at Rhodes Central, Marquet Street, Rhodes (2138105).
  • Route 533 towards Chatswood services will pick up and drop off at Marquet Street opposite Rhodes Central, Rhodes (2138106). 
  • Passengers needing to access Wentworth Point can catch buses to Olympic Park Station to connect with Route 526 services leaving from Park Street towards Wentworth Point. 
  • Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Billbergia Bennelong Bridge Run website for more details. 
Missed stops
  • Bennelong Bridge after Shoreline Drive, Rhodes (2138107) 
  • Footbridge Boulevard opposite Marina Square, Wentworth Point (2127110) 
  • Hill Road at Half Street, Wentworth Point (212752) 
  • Hill Road at Nuvolari Place, Wentworth Point (212793) 
  • Hill Road at Stromboli Strait, Wentworth Point (212719) 
  • Holker Busway after Hill Road, Sydney Olympic Park (2127100) 
  • Holker Busway before Hill Road, Sydney Olympic Park (2127113) 
  • Hill Road opposite Stromboli Strait, Wentworth Point (212715) 
  • Hill Road opposite Nuvolari Place, Sydney Olympic Park (212746) 
  • Hill Road opposite Half Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212797) 
  • Marina Square, Footbridge Boulevard, Wentworth Point (2127109) 
  • Bennelong Bridge before Shoreline Drive, Rhodes (2138108)
subtitle: Wentworth Point diversions during Fun Run

  • Sunday from 7.30am to 11.30am, at Scarborough, Wombarra and Coledale, all trains leave from platform 1.
